device.description: 16-bit 200 kSPS single-channel SAR ADC with SPI/DSP serial output (CS and FS)
device.note: tlc4541.pdf (SLAS293) p.1 pinouts, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing requirements (td1/td2/td3, tconv 2.94 us), p.12-14 control and timing (reset cycle, sampling, conversion, serial output data format, SPI CPOL 0 / CPHA 1), p.17 binary output format and auto-power down

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (timing), p.12-14 (reset, conversion, output format, SPI mode), p.17 (binary format, auto-power down)
notModeled: analog input, external reference (REF); the result is the 0 V code (0000h)
FS (DSP frame sync) control: FS low at CS falling makes the FS rising edge start the frame and release SDO (FS-only and CS+FS modes); FS is modeled as tied to VDD (SPI mode, p.13)
sampling (20 SCLKs from the 5th SCLK) and the conversion start after the 24th SCLK falling edge: modeled as a 2.94 us conversion started at CS rising; SDO carries the previous cycle's result (p.12)
power-on RESET/initialization cycle (CS low for 1 to 8 SCLK falling edges) and the FF00h code output after a reset cycle or a prematurely terminated conversion (p.12)
SDO goes Hi-Z at the 17th SCLK rising edge (p.3, p.6 Note 4); modeled as Hi-Z after the 16-bit frame (idle z) and at CS rising
auto-power down after each conversion (woken by CS falling) - no effect on the bus (p.17)
SCLK frequency limits (100 kHz to 15 MHz), sample time limits (p.4, p.6)
variants: TLC4541: single-ended AIN, separate FS pin (pin 7), SCLK on pin 5; TLC4545: pseudo-differential AIN0(+)/AIN1(-), SCLK on pin 7, no FS. Same 16-bit frame and timing; pin compatible with the 14-bit TLC3541/TLC3545.
